children: Coinbase (COIN) filed Form 1‑N with the SEC to register Coinbase Derivatives as a national exchange to list security futures, seeking approval to offer perpetual futures on large‑cap U.S. stocks.
SEC issued a five-year Innovation Exemption for tokenized securities venues. Coinbase (COIN) has said it plans to offer tokenized stocks in the U.S. pending rules; analysts noted competitive impact.
COIN included in a proposal to let single-stock futures stay open without scheduled rollovers, filed after CME launched standard and micro single-stock futures; proposal awaits regulatory approval.
Coinbase (COIN) expanded its Morpho-powered USDC lending to Brazil, routing app USDC into an audited Morpho vault via Steakhouse Financial with no lock-up; returns follow on-chain borrow demand.
COIN launched regulated crypto futures in Canada for eligible traders: 23 crypto futures (Bitcoin, Ether, Solana), plus futures for gold, silver, oil and the COIN50 index.
Proposal: cash-settled perpetuals tied to Coinbase (COIN) offering leveraged long/short exposure, no expiry, recurring funding to track stock price, roughly 24/5 trading with three scheduling groups
Coinbase (COIN): CEO Brian Armstrong said defeat of the CLARITY Act would lift ethics limits on token promotions and remove state AG enforcement and blind trust rules tied to token promotion.
